perguntas.r: Tickets are sold by Tickett. Choose your ticket on the tickets page and pay at checkout.

perguntas.p: Will I get my ticket by email?
perguntas.r: Yes. After you buy, your ticket is sent to the email address you give. Check your spam folder too.

perguntas.p: Can I change or refund my ticket?
perguntas.r: The terms for changes and refunds are shown at Tickett's checkout. Please read them before you pay. We will publish more details by June.

perguntas.p: What time do the doors open?
perguntas.r: The doors open at 16:00 on both days. Check the final time for each day before you set off.

perguntas.p: Do I need to bring a printed ticket?
perguntas.r: We will publish this information by June. In the meantime, keep the email confirming your purchase.

perguntas.p: Is there a minimum age to get in?
perguntas.r: The minimum age is not confirmed yet. We will publish this information by June.
Yes. Kizomba na Rua runs on both days of the festival. Check the day and time on the line-up.

perguntas.p: What can I bring into the festival site?
perguntas.r: We will publish this information by June, with the list of permitted and prohibited items.

perguntas.p: How do I get to the festival site?
perguntas.r: The festival takes place at Estádio Olivais e Moscavide, in Moscavide, Lisbon. You will find the transport options on the Getting there page.

perguntas.p: How do I pay on site?
perguntas.r: You pay on site with the cashless wristband. We will publish by June how to top up the balance.

perguntas.p: Can I get a refund for my wristband balance?
perguntas.r: Yes. The balance can be refunded online after the festival. The deadline will be announced on the festival's social media.

perguntas.p: What if I lose my wristband?
perguntas.r: We will publish this information by June.
We are preparing the accessibility information. We will publish it by June.

perguntas.p: Are there reserved spaces for people with reduced mobility?
perguntas.r: We will publish this information by June. If you need support, write to us through the festival's social media.

perguntas.p: How do I ask for support on the day of the festival?
perguntas.r: Tell us about your needs before the festival, through our social media, so that we can prepare the support.
